login.loadingText: Reparing to log in to WeChat
login.qrcodeTitle: Scan the QR code to log in to WeChat
login.scannedTitle: Scan the QR code to complete
login.scannedTip: Confirmation of login is required on the mobile phone

channel.title: Solution
channel.content: Make sure that the phone associated with this account is nearby and WeChat is opened on the phone. If it still doesn't work, you can go to the "Settings" on WeChat of the watch, log out, and then log in again.

setting.title: Settings
setting.cleanTip: If WeChat functions abnormally, you can try clearing the cache to fix it.
setting.cleanBtnTip: Clear cache and log in again
setting.cleanedNotice: The cache has been cleared. You need to scan the QR code to log in again.
setting.cleanedTip: If problems still occur during use, you can try to restart the watch, update WeChat, or contact our customer service team.
setting.cleanFailedTip: Clear cache requires connecting to mobile phone
setting.logoutTip: No historical data will be retained after logging out, and you will need to scan the QR code again for the next login.

pay.bind_tip: WeChat Pay is not yet enabled. Please use your mobile WeChat to scan the QR code to enable payment.
pay.bind_title: Scan the QR code to enable WeChat Pay
pay.binding_tip: Enabling... Please finish the process on your phone.
pay.bind_error: The current network is not available. Please check if the connected phone is connected to the internet.
pay.bind_unconnected: Phone not connected. Make sure Bluetooth is turned on.
pay.bind_exit: If you exit the current page, the payment code will not be able to be opened. Are you sure you want to close it?
pay.pay_tip: This function is used to pay merchants. Please do not send the payment code to others.
pay.pay_manage_tip: You can manage payment capabilities in "Me > Services > Wallet > Payment Settings > Pay" by Watch or Band.
pay.unbind_tip: After suspending WeChat Pay, you will not be able to make payments using WeChat Pay.
pay.unbind_tip_ios: After unlinking the device, you cannot make payments using WeChat Pay.
pay.already_stop_pay: WeChat Pay has been temporarily suspended
pay.wechatUserNotice: Your account does not currently support WeChat Pay.
